Food & drinks

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Pasta and risotto

Carbonara, arrabbiata, lasagne and risotto with mushrooms. Guests say the dishes are cooked with care.

Pizza

19 reviews mention the pizza. Guests who come every week name pizza and pasta as their favourites.

Cocktails

28 reviews mention the cocktails, among them the Mai Tai. Good coffee is served too.

Tiramisu and more

Tiramisu and a chocolate ganache dessert, and for those who want something else, burgers, steak and chicken.

From the kitchen

Photos from the Google listing of Bella Vita.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The garden

Guests describe an inner garden with bougainvillea, benches with soft pillows, fairy lights and calm music.

Fireplace in winter

Inside, a 50s Nicosia mansion with old stone walls, art on the walls and a fireplace. 6 reviews mention the fireplace.

Family run

A small family business. 13 reviews mention the kind staff, and guests describe the owners as welcoming.

An old house in the old town

Bella Vita sits on Archangelou Michael in the old town, away from the tourist bustle of Ledra Street. Open every evening from 18:00, and on weekends also for lunch.

What guests say

Three of 318 Google reviews, 245 of them with five stars.

“Bella Vita is a wonderful restaurant offering excellent Italian cuisine at very competitive prices. The food is authentic and delicious, the service is attentive, and the owners are incredibly kind and welcoming. The beautiful internal garden makes the atmosphere even more special. Highly recommended!”
